journey.name: Lift: the timers coach aloud
journey.description: Lift's timers speak through the same voice as the interval side's cues, and only where a lifter is still: the rest after a set of a ballistic or hinge lift says one fault it is prone to, and in its last ten seconds the next lift's set-up; an EMOM's count-in says one of the lift's cues, each minute the next, and a minute's set done the next fault. The set's card shows the worst fault under its figure. A program day opening on a thrown lift at a bell new to it says "Groove five light first". Settings' Voice switch silences Lift too. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval), with the emulator's volume up and a text-to-speech engine installed.

actions.action: On the welcome, which a fresh install opens on, tap "Skip to Set up", then "Skip for now" on "Set up"
Tap the "Train" tab, which opens on "Strength", then "Start session"
Verify that the "Next set" card shows, under the figure doing a two-hand swing, "Watch for · Hips back, shins stay vertical"
Tap the title bar's "Add set or EMOM", tap "Change", search "snatch" and tap "Snatch"
Tap the sheet's "Log set" and verify that the rest counts down from "1:30" and the phone says "Punch through before it lands" as it starts
Wait until the rest reads "0:10" and verify that the phone says "Hike the bell high, drive the hips and pull the elbow back to keep the arc close" before the 3-2-1 beeps
Verify that the "Next set" card shows "Watch for · Punch through before it lands" under the figure doing a snatch
Tap "Add set or EMOM", then "An EMOM", then "Start EMOM", and verify that during "Get ready" the phone says the snatch's first cue
Once the minute's "Work" shows, tap "Set done" and verify that the phone says "Hips back, shins stay vertical"
Verify that about nine seconds before the next minute, ahead of its 3-2-1, the phone says "Open the hand near the top and punch through so the bell settles softly overhead"
Let the next minute pass without tapping "Set done" and verify that nothing is said before the minute after it
Tap "Follow a program", tap "20 minutes beside BJJ", then "Follow this program", and tap "Start day 1": verify that the phone says "Groove five light first" as the session opens
Tap Back and verify that "Leave the session?" says nothing is logged yet, so the session isn't kept; tap "Leave"
Open Settings from Train's gear, turn "Voice" off and go back to Train
Tap "Start day 1" and verify that nothing is said as the session opens

Tap the title bar's "Add set or EMOM" and the sheet's "Log set" (day 1 is an EMOM day, so the foot offers "Start EMOM"), wait for the rest to end, and verify that only the beeps play, with nothing said
